about_the_game:
Create a quartet of castles that hide powerful secrets in their gooey walls with the KR Legendary Palaces - Slime Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is giving our favorite starter enemy the attention they deserve with an MV/MZ-sized tileset ready to turn a boring dungeon into a slime’s paradise. A1, A2, A4, and A5 tiles come in red, yellow, green, and blue so that you can build bright rocky halls that lead to smooth rooms with puddles of goopy slime and pits that lead deeper into the dungeon.

This pack also includes character sprites for fires, treasure chests, and sparkles that match the tiles’ red, yellow, green, and blue themes so you can keep a consistent color for the dungeon, or try using green or yellow sparkles in a blue room to make sure it catches your players’ eyes! Pick up the KR Legendary Palaces - Slime Tileset and remind your players that slimes are more dangerous than they appear!


The Legendary Palace ~ Slime Tileset Includes (in blue, green, red and yellow):

Ground Tiles:

Slime puddles (with "waterfall" versions)
Plain floor
Fancy tile
Rough rock-like tile
Small jelly tile pattern
Jelly puddle
"Spike" tile
Hole tile

Walls:

Wall tiles to match floor tiles.

Also featuring:

stairs to match flooring
small accent pillars
large accent pillars (plain and themed)
plain arch
detailed arch
raised platform
coordinated throne
slimy jeweled accents
treasure chest (with animated version)
push block
bridge rails
multiple statues – large and small
magic rings
jelly slope (a stair replacement)
3 designs of ladders
plus more!

Events and Animations

Treasure chest
Flames
Twinkle animations


Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
